title: Reliable published/preview media loading with correct backend publish wiring and diagnostics

requirements.summary: Wire Media Manager publishing to the new per-slot backend media publish/clear capabilities (replace current no-op placeholder call) and surface publish failures to the user in English.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes shared methods to (a) publish/replace a hero background, (b) publish/replace a single image slot, (c) publish/replace a single video slot, (d) publish/replace the background song, and (e) clear each of those targets.
Frontend publishMediaToBackend(...) uses these new APIs to upload exactly the staged draft deltas (uploads and clears) instead of calling actor.publishMedia() with no payload.
If the backend publish step fails, the frontend shows an English error message and does not silently report success.

file_operations.description: Replace the publishMediaToBackend placeholder implementation with real calls to the backend actor’s per-type methods (setHeroBackground/setImage/setVideo/setBackgroundSong and clearHeroBackground/clearImage/clearVideo/clearBackgroundSong), uploading only changed draft deltas. Use the blob-storage ExternalBlob client to convert File bytes into ExternalBlob and to provide direct URLs; support per-file progress via ExternalBlob.withUploadProgress and route progress events through onProgress. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure backend publish failures are normalized into an English diagnostic payload and returned as a failed PublishResult (so the Media Manager remains open and shows the error). Keep the publish flow sequencing (precheck → backend publish → local apply → record deployment) but rely on the updated publishMediaToBackend behavior (no actor.publishMedia placeholder).

requirements.summary: Fix publishedMediaClient.fetchPublishedMedia() mapping to correctly interpret the backend PublishedMedia shape (tuples + optional slots) and return stable renderable URLs for hero, images, videos, and song in published/preview mode.
acceptanceCriteria: When getPublishedMedia() contains a published hero background, at least one image, at least one video, and/or a song, fetchPublishedMedia() returns non-null heroUrl/songUrl and Maps containing the expected slot indices for images/videos.
The frontend no longer shows pink/blank placeholders due to URL construction/mapping errors when backend media exists.
Console errors related to 'Failed to fetch published media' are not emitted during normal successful published-mode loads.

file_operations.description: Harden fetchPublishedMedia() to correctly handle the backend PublishedMedia fields (including tuple items like [name, ExternalBlob] and optional hero/song), tolerate undefined/null slots, and avoid throwing during normal mapping. Ensure image/video slot indices map consistently to UI indices (images 1–43, videos 1–6) and URLs are produced via ExternalBlob.getDirectURL(). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure MediaStoreContext startup rehydration in published/preview mode falls back to backend-published media when local IndexedDB is absent, while preserving local-first behavior when local media exists.
acceptanceCriteria: On a fresh browser session with empty IndexedDB/localStorage, the app loads published media from the backend and displays hero background, images, videos, and song (if they were published).
When local IndexedDB media exists, local media continues to take precedence for fast preview, with backend as fallback only for missing items.
The one-time startup diagnostic log clearly reports counts for local vs backend vs merged media in English.

file_operations.description: Adjust startup rehydration/merge logic to ensure backend-published media is used as a fallback for any missing local hero/image/video/song items (including the fully-empty-local case), without overriding locally available items. Ensure the one-time startup log remains exactly one structured English console log and accurately reports local/backend/merged counts.

Align fetchPublishedMedia() return shape with MediaStoreContext’s fallback merge needs (heroUrl/songUrl nullable; imageUrls/videoUrls Maps keyed by slot index), so MediaStoreContext can reliably merge backend media into missing local slots without mapping inconsistencies. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update the Media Manager Submit/publish flow so the live UI immediately reflects submitted media (including order/transforms) without refresh, and the dialog closes only after successful backend publish (if applicable) and local apply.
acceptanceCriteria: After clicking Submit, the Image Memory section immediately renders all uploaded/replaced images according to the submitted imageOrder and saved per-slot transforms, without requiring a reload.
After clicking Submit, the Video Memory section immediately renders all uploaded/replaced videos without requiring a reload.
After clicking Submit, MusicPlayer uses the newly submitted song (or falls back to /song.mp3 when cleared) and can be played via the existing play button.
The dialog closes only after backend publish (if applicable) and local apply succeed, and any user-facing failure text is in English.

file_operations.description: Ensure the publish() promise only resolves success after both backend publish and MediaStoreContext.batchPublish (local apply + live state update) succeed; on any failure, return a failed PublishResult so MediaManager keeps the dialog open with English error details.

Confirm batchPublish applies imageOrder and per-slot transforms atomically alongside media URL updates so ImageMemorySection/VideoMemorySection/HeroSection/MusicPlayer reflect changes immediately after Submit with no refresh.

Keep the dialog-close behavior gated on the publish hook’s succeeded state, and ensure failure states do not close the dialog. Remove any duplicate success-side effects that could mask failures; keep all new/changed user-facing messages in English.

requirements.summary: Add lightweight production-focused diagnostics: exactly one structured console log on app start and exactly one structured console log per Submit summarizing media actions and whether order/transforms changed.
acceptanceCriteria: On app start, exactly one English console log summarizes local vs backend availability and merged results (hero/images/videos/song).

On each Submit, exactly one English console log summarizes: hero action, image upload count, image clear count, video upload count, video clear count, song action, and whether imageOrder/transforms changed.
No user-facing UI copy is added in any language other than English.

file_operations.description: Remove the per-Submit console log from MediaManager to avoid duplicate Submit logs; rely on a single centralized structured log emitted by the publish hook. Ensure no other new user-facing copy is introduced except English.

Emit exactly one structured English console log per Submit attempt that includes hero action, image/video upload+clear counts, song action, and whether imageOrder/transforms changed. Remove any additional publish-related console logs (e.g., 'Published to backend') to keep the per-Submit log count to exactly one.
Ensure the app-start diagnostic remains exactly one structured English console log for media availability/merge (no additional startup logs added).
